On an undated web page (page content as of July 12, 2026), Raymond James describes its RIA & Custody Services division as giving independent RIAs true strategic, financial and administrative control to grow their business their way, using as much or as little of the firm's support as needed.

Whether the mix across the affiliation models has shifted over the periods disclosed: on this evidence the comparison is valid only in part. The 10-K discloses channel headcounts rather than a mix series—as of September 30, 2023, 2024 and 2025, employee financial advisors were 3,693, 3,826 and 3,878, and independent contractor financial advisors were 5,019, 4,961 and 5,065, with financial advisors associated with RCS firms excluded from those counts—so these are headcounts by channel, not a computed mix. Management's own statements do describe a shift: on the fiscal fourth quarter 2024 earnings call, the then-CEO said that in fiscal 2024 the employee channel led recruiting by total dollars after the independent channel had led a couple of years earlier, and that RCS had the highest percentage growth; on the fiscal first quarter 2026 earnings call, the CEO said recruiting activity is broad-based across affiliation options but "maybe more heavily tilted in the last six months on the independent contractor side of the business"; and on the fiscal second quarter 2026 earnings call, the CEO said much more of its recruiting over the last year has come from the independent side versus the employee side, so "there's just a mix shift there to some extent."
